Long-Term Mental Wellness Practices

The slower habits that keep you well over months rather than hours: boundaries, hobbies, reflection and community. Come back to it whenever you want to see where the balance has drifted.

Wellbeing · Habits · Boundaries · Values · 6 items · once a day

The checklist

  • Develop healthy boundaries — Say no when needed.
  • Nurture hobbies — Engage in activities that bring joy.
  • Schedule time for reflection — Regular check-ins on progress.
  • Educate yourself — Learn about mental health to reduce stigma.
  • Volunteer or engage with community — Giving back can boost well-being.
  • Prioritize balance — Avoid burnout by adjusting workload and self-care.

Use this checklist Free account: tick items off and keep each day's record.

How to use it

Run through it once a day, honestly and without scoring yourself. A checklist is a way of noticing, not a test: an item you cannot tick is information about the day, not a verdict on you. Over a few weeks the pattern of what gets ticked and what does not says more than any single pass.

With a free Theraglee account the checklist remembers each pass, so you can look back. Without one, you can still read it here and keep your own copy.
